item.title: Harry Potter en de Halfbloed Prins (Dutch Edition)
item.description:
Harry Potter en de Halfbloed Prins (Dutch Edition) by J.K. Rowling

Summary

“Harry Potter en de Halfbloed Prins” is the sixth installment in J.K. Rowling’s beloved Harry Potter series. The novel follows Harry Potter’s sixth year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As the wizarding world faces turmoil with the rise of dark forces led by Lord Voldemort, Harry discovers a mysterious potions book that once belonged to the “Half-Blood Prince.” Guided by its annotations, Harry excels in potions class but is also drawn deeper into the dark secrets it holds. Key themes include the exploration of identity, the struggles of adolescence, and the battle between good and evil. Critical plot points involve Harry’s lessons with Professor Dumbledore to better understand Voldemort’s past and the complexities of his Horcruxes, paving the way for the ultimate confrontation.
